name: Clean Up Time
summary: In Clean Up Time, cowboy cleaners Otto and Bobban must tidy up a vandalized hotel before staff and guests arrive. Across eight platform levels, you collect scattered paper while using stairs and poles, dodging or shooting enemies. With a timer ticking, limited lives, and only three smart bombs per level, each floor becomes a frantic race. Collecting a bucket grants bonus points – and in two-player mode, both players clean up simultaneously on screen.
